problem: During live CDC 2.11.2 consumer adoption, a direct text edit inserted a Markdown status section immediately after the opening frontmatter delimiter in docs/work-status/current.md. The full package suite still passed, but validate_checkpoint_24.py correctly rejected the checkpoint as invalid YAML before lease release.

hypotheses.statement: The released checkpoint parser or YAML loader regressed on a previously valid document.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect the exact validator failure and compare the pre-edit and corrected checkpoint layout.
hypotheses.observed_result: The validator reported invalid YAML at the inserted prose before the schema key; after relocating the prose below the closing delimiter, the same validator passed.

hypotheses.statement: The 2.11.2 adapter/checkpoint schema combination is incompatible with the consumer.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Run the final corrected adapter/checkpoint validation with unchanged 2.11.2 policy and checkpoint semantics.
hypotheses.observed_result: Run 36763362845 passed strict adapter validation and checkpoint v4 validation without changing the schema or policy contract.

hypotheses.statement: The executor bypassed the existing schema-typed checkpoint builder/pre-commit validation discipline and performed a fragile textual splice at the first frontmatter delimiter.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Trace the write that introduced the failure and compare it with the released checkpoint-builder/pre-commit validation contract.
hypotheses.observed_result: The write inserted prose immediately after the first delimiter; no checkpoint builder or pre-write validation was used. The existing validator then caught the malformed state before authority release.

correction: Reinforce the existing checkpoint-builder/pre-commit-validation control: CDC-authored checkpoint mutations must use the schema-aware builder or an equivalent parsed-structure update, and must validate the exact bytes before committing. Body prose insertion must target the closing frontmatter delimiter, never the first delimiter by string position.
defense_in_depth: Retain a regression covering Markdown-body insertion around frontmatter boundaries and require consumer-adoption finalization to validate the exact final checkpoint bytes after all status prose edits and before lease ready/release.
invariant: CDC never releases ownership from a checkpoint write that has not been parsed and validated in its exact final byte form; direct textual splicing cannot bypass the schema-aware checkpoint write path.
